title: Reconsider modality / asset selection
rationale: Starts the IRA clock; a biologic extends the runway.
detail: Evaluate the value case for follow-on assets and formulation strategy against the 11-year biologic negotiation timeline.

title: Optimize indication sequencing
rationale: Orphan-first sequencing delays IRA selection and earns EU protection.
detail: Compare launch and filing order by indication, with orphan designation status confirmed in the US and EU.

title: Optimize pre-launch evidence
rationale: Comparative SoC data strengthens JCA and MFN positioning.
detail: Prioritize comparative evidence that can support assessment needs across the EU and inform US pricing exposure.

title: Build post-launch evidence
rationale: Real-world evidence supports IRA, MFN and JCA.
detail: Establish a post-launch evidence plan with clear ownership, endpoints, and governance checkpoints.

title: Align EMA, JCA and HTA planning
rationale: Aligned timelines avoid up to 12 months of EU delay.
detail: Coordinate submission milestones and early national HTA engagement to reduce avoidable sequencing delays.
